summary: Listed site in Parry Sound District: firelookout.ca describes a wooden first tower and a 100 ft steel tower. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Steel tower; an earlier wooden tower stood on the site

evidence.supports: Location: Unorganized Centre Parry Sound, Parry Sound District, Ontario
evidence.quote: Unorganized Centre Parry Sound, Parry Sound District, Central Ontario, Ontario, Canada

evidence.supports: First tower was wooden, of hewn spruce timbers, and framed
evidence.quote: Originally, a wooden tower built of hewn spruce timbers and framed.

evidence.supports: Posts 66 ft long set into concrete bases
evidence.quote: Support posts 66' long and set into concrete bases.

evidence.supports: Guy wires anchored with rock bolts
evidence.quote: Supported by guy wires anchored with rock bolts.

evidence.supports: A new steel tower appears to have been built on the site
evidence.quote: It appears that a new 100' steel tower was built at this site.

evidence.supports: Department of Lands and Forests map shows a 100 ft steel tower at the location
evidence.quote: The Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map shows a 100 foot steel tower at this location.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one community-submitted directory page (firelookout.ca). The wooden first tower and the 100 ft steel tower rest on one 'It appears' sentence and a Lands and Forests map the page only refers to. No build date appears anywhere, so no events are recorded. height_m 30.5 is 100 ft converted; the page does not say whether that is structure height or to the cab floor. Wikipedia's list of the Parry Sound Forest Fire District's 21 lookouts does not name Rye (or Sand Lake), so the tower's place in that network is unconfirmed. Two searches found no other source. Status and access are left unknown. Not checked on site.
